one_line: A document workspace where humans grant scoped agent capabilities and retain attributed, reversible revisions.
what_it_does: Lets a user select document content, assign an agent/access profile, run structured work, and preserve diffs, sources, and history.
leverage_rationale: WebMCP is central to the claimed capability-grant model: the live page exposes only the selected catalog and shares document state with the agent. General UI driving could imitate actions but would be less reliable and would not naturally enforce the stated scoped surface.
leverage_evidence: Pitch describes human-selected access profiles mapped to the live WebMCP catalog.
Frame sheets show document selection, bot invocation, evidence panels, and revision/history states.
execution_rationale: The frame sheets show a coherent, intentional incident-document workflow with contextual invocation, output, and proof-oriented UI, but no runnable video is supplied and static frames cannot establish end-to-end completion.
execution_evidence: Frames consistently show an incident postmortem, selected passages, agent controls, and persistent evidence/results.
Devpost packaging includes a named demo and coherent product description.
impact_rationale: Incident and launch documentation teams have a credible need for traceable, reviewable agent edits; preserving rationale and attribution addresses a real operational problem.
impact_evidence: Description identifies loss of requests, sources, authorship, and rationale in ordinary AI-assisted documents.
UI example is an engineering checkout-outage postmortem.
creativity_rationale: The combination of capability grants, contextual bot assignments, and proof-preserving document revisions is a fresh and memorable interaction model.
creativity_evidence: Repeated framing emphasizes highlight, mention, run, and keep the proof.
Frames depict a document-native agent workflow rather than a separate chat panel.
usability_note: Clear document-centered flow and contextual controls; dense evidence panels may need validation.
red_flags: No actual video or transcript despite referenced frame sheets; functionality is primarily claimed/static evidence.
standouts: Strong permission model and auditability concept.
Human/agent shared-state framing is unusually specific.
advance_reason: Strong WebMCP-specific concept with credible impact and coherent visual evidence, despite limited functional proof.

one_line: A scientist-agent co-design studio for validated 96-well plates with locks, metrics, recovery, and controlled export.
what_it_does: Maintains versioned plate state; agents read identities, generate alternatives, compare metrics, apply reversible layouts, validate, and prepare CSV export while humans approve.
leverage_rationale: Precise semantic operations over sample IDs, well IDs, locks, and state versions solve the core failure mode of coordinate automation. Human and agent share live state and stale edits can be recovered.
leverage_evidence: Description explicitly contrasts semantic well operations with fragile click-many-cells automation.
Nine tools cover exact reads, deterministic alternatives, comparison, reversible apply, stale-state recovery, validation, and export preparation.
execution_rationale: The packet presents a tightly scoped, coherent workflow and the screenshot/frames show plate design, sample protection, quality scoring, and review/export, but no end-to-end video proves execution.
execution_evidence: Devpost screenshot visibly shows Generate alternatives, Protect the sample, Move & lock, Layout quality 83/100, and Review & export.
Description explains shared versioned state and deterministic validation.
impact_rationale: Laboratory staff face real costly errors in dense microplate allocation; preserving samples and validating exports provides direct, credible niche value.
impact_evidence: Problem statement names sample identity, controls, replicates, edge effects, and pipetting order.
Human approval and synthetic/no-patient-data framing appropriately bound the claim.
creativity_rationale: Applying state-aware WebMCP collaboration to 96-well spatial design is a distinctive, technically deep interaction model.
creativity_evidence: Human locks plus deterministic agent alternatives and stale-state recovery.
Page-enforced constraints and measurable trade-offs are pursued coherently.
usability_note: The protected-sample and review stages make a complex scientific workflow legible.
red_flags: Static frames and packaging evidence do not prove actual tool calls or export correctness.
standouts: Excellent WebMCP fit for dense spatial state.
advance_reason: Strongest combination of WebMCP indispensability, real audience need, and coherent demonstrated scope.
